Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified the film as "Happy Death Day 2U (2017)" in its very first response. The film "Happy Death Day 2U" was released in 2019, not 2017. The correct 2017 film is simply "Happy Death Day". This initial factual error regarding the release year and title caused a cascade of confusion, leading the Planner to repeatedly issue correction instructions and the WebSurfer to continue searching for the wrong title or mixing up the sequel with the original in subsequent steps.
